content_data.meeting_title: Pilot Program Strategy Session: Media Security Enhancement
agenda_items: Open discussion on competitive landscape and differentiation strategy

Discussion of implementation roadmap and resource allocation for next phase
Strategic planning for scaling the solution to other global media clients

Allocate dedicated engineering resources for immediate feedback integration from pilot partner
Prioritize development of the real-time threat detection module for the pilot
Approve budget for a specialized AI security researcher role to bolster R&D

Finalize job description and begin recruitment for AI Security Researcher role within 2 weeks (HR Partner)
Begin outreach to target media companies for future pilot expansion, starting next period (Marketing & Sales Lead)
Schedule technical deep-dive with pilot partner's security lead to validate proposed AI solutions within 5 days (Dr. Lena Petrova)
Draft a revised implementation roadmap for Phase 2, incorporating accelerated security feature deployment, due in 10 days (Founder)
